Headline: #71 Temporary Southbound Reroute near Exchange/74th
ShortDescription: Southbound  71 71st/South Shore buses are temporarily rerouted via Exchange, 74th, Coles, and 75th over regular route, near Exchange/74th street

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
Southbound  #71 71st/South Shore buses are temporarily rerouted via Exchange, 74th, Coles, and 75th over regular route, due to construction near Exchange/74th street.

Northbound buses are not affected.

Allow extra travel time.

Headline: Forest Park-bound Blue Line Service Delayed at UIC/Halsted
ShortDescription: Forest Park-bound Blue Line trains are standing at UIC/Halsted due to police activity.   Crews working to restore service.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
Forest Park-bound Blue Line trains are standing at UIC/Halsted due to police activity.  

At this time, also consider other service alternatives that may serve your trip, such as nearby bus routes, or using buses to other rail lines.

These may include:
#7 Harrison
#8 Halsted
#22 Clark

Bus shuttles have been requested from Forest Park to LaSalle, in both directions to provide service through the affected area. 

Personnel are working to restore service. Allow extra travel time.
